headline: One banknote.
One very quiet city.
story: Base City went quiet. The builders moved on, the streets emptied, and the lights in the towers went out one by one.
Then a single banknote walked in. Cashy, the Base Note, denomination 8453: the chain ID of Base itself. He isn’t here to be spent. He’s here to rebuild.

Every $CASHY trade runs on Feel.cash, in a pool paired with NVDAc, Coinbase’s tokenized Nvidia stock. 2.14% of every trade goes back to holders, paid in NVDA, about once a day. Each payout is a Payday, and each Payday turns another light back on in Base City.
As more Base projects move in, they get their own building, and their characters take over the streets. One block at a time, the quiet city becomes the Base Renaissance.
about.mascotAlt: Cashy, a banknote in sunglasses and a leather jacket, grinning and holding a ray gun.

cards.title: Everyone knows it
cards.text: Nvidia is a household name. Nobody needs it explained, from a trader in New York to a student in Lagos.

cards.title: Same green
cards.text: Nvidia green, Cashy green. The note was already wearing the colour.

cards.title: The AI money machine
cards.text: Nvidia is the name everyone connects with the AI boom. Cashy shares its trading fees in it.

cards.title: Built on chips
cards.text: Base City’s games, the arcade and every AI idea run on chips. The Chip Factory is where Cashy makes them.

why.note: Paired with NVDAc on Feel.cash. Not affiliated with Nvidia.
